controlledComparison.scope: Authored serial VT decoding with full CPU byte comparison, two trials per version; same DLL/guest boot. This is not Safari presentation fps.

notificationRepair.cause: Barrier/end/cancel predicate fields were mutated outside the condition-variable mutex. A notification could fall between the predicate check and the wait, leaving a successful operation asleep until its twenty-second deadline.
notificationRepair.fix: Publish predicate transitions while holding pendingMutex, then notify. Assign distinct requested barrier sequence numbers under writeMutex.
notificationRepair.deterministicRegression: native/VideoBridge/DecoderWakeTest.cpp: forces publication to start inside the predicate-to-wait interval; passes on Windows/MSVC and the Intel VM/libc++.

youtubeObservation.qualification: Public adaptive playback observation, not an A/B benchmark or sustained 4K60 proof.

coldBoot.lockUnlockObservation: Desktop returned after both unlocks; no observed freeze. The animated lock screen required wake input before its password field appeared.
